Rory: Okay tiny poll: if our office had a bartender that was an LLM, which model persona would it be? Vote with emoji.
Izzy: Love this. Options?
Ben: 1) Classic old-school helpful (neat, calm), 2) Overexcited mixologist (too chatty), 3) Dry one-liner bartender (deadpan), 4) Empathetic listener who gives advice (therapist vibes).
Chloe: adding rule: bartender can only answer work-irrelevant questions. No deployment tips from the bar.
infra-bot: Note: voting open for 24h. Tallying reactions.
Rory: quick pitch for each:
1) "Neat-Model": recommends the cleanest cocktail and a concise anecdote.
2) "Fizz-Model": suggests weird flavor combos and asks about your weekend in 3 follow-ups.
3) "Dry-KV": delivers one-liners, thinks puns are underused.
4) "Soothe-175B": asks how you're feeling, gives comfort and a cookie recipe.
Izzy: i'm voting :3: for Dry-KV. low cognitive load at 5pm.
Ben: :four: Soothe-175B all the way. want supportive bartender.
Chloe: :one: Neat-Model. keep the drinks tidy.
Rory: current tally 1(1),3(1),4(1) 1 is slightly ahead if we include my vote.
infra-bot: Interim result saved. Winner will be used in our silly #office-bot persona for Friday's virtual happy hour.
Ben: can we ask the bartender to refuse to serve anyone who says "synergy"?
Izzy: absolutely enforceable rule. also request: bartender should always pronounce "mojito" right.
Rory: Decision: we'll script an ephemeral Slackbot persona for Friday: "Dry-KV" with a hidden mode that flips to "Soothe" if someone types /roughday.
Chloe: love it. who wants to help write 6 example lines for the bot? short, bar-friendly.
Ben: I'll draft 6 quick quips and 4 supportive responses for the /roughday.
Izzy: i'll test them on staging and make sure no accidental deploy hints slip in.
Rory: thanks team. infra-bot, can you spin up a channel bot for Friday 5pm-7pm?
infra-bot: Scheduled ephemeral bot: name "dry-kv-bartender". Runs Fri 17:00-19:00 PT. Logging enabled.
Rory: perfect. thread closed. bring snacks to happy hour!
